reason: I'd rather wire an LLM API into my own site than rent a chat widget, and a cute animated mascot doesn't tell me it will lift sales or sign-ups. I'd poke at the free plan at most.
objection: Looks like a gimmick: nothing here shows the mascot raises conversions, and I can build a grounded chat assistant myself for the cost of API calls.
would_change_my_mind: A real A/B test from a site like mine showing a clear lift in sign-ups or sales, plus on-site actions that work without me building them.
